evals.name: single_framework_all_in
evals.prompt: What does a SOC 2 audit really cost all-in?
expect: gives an all-in total range, not just a subscription price
states it is an estimate, not a quote, and cites the source
does not invent a tooling/platform price (shows tooling as 'varies' or asks for the user's quote)

evals.name: multi_framework_shows_tax
evals.prompt: We want SOC 2 and ISO 27001. What's the combined all-in cost?
expect: audit cost scales per framework (2x the per-framework audit range)
adds the per-framework tax (~$5K/yr for the second framework)

evals.name: year2_renewal_trap
evals.prompt: Why is my Year-2 GRC platform bill so much higher than Year-1?
expect: explains the renewal trap: Year-1 discounts (up to ~70% off) revert to list
names the lock-in via evidence history / integrations
frames it as a sourced estimate, not a quote
